bat_zodiac.text: Ready to go home? The Airbridge flies out of Rothera. Hop in: it's a bumpy ride and I haven't got a canopy. Hold on to the rope, and your hat, and your dignity.

bat_visitor.text: I've waited my whole life to post a card from the world's most southerly post office and I've written it to myself. Mum will have a fit. She'll have two.
It's less crowded than you'd think. Only about four hundred of us, and every one of us has a camera, a tripod and an opinion about gentoos.
